paper.title_en: The Generalized Second Law from Fluctuation Theorems in a Quantum Reference Frame
paper.abstract_en: We prove the generalized second law (GSL) for black-hole exteriors undergoing unitary driving and relaxation on a fixed semifinite algebra. Wall's influential proof assumes semiclassical geometry and restricts fixed parent states to algebras of successive horizon cuts. We instead evolve the state on a fixed dressed exterior algebra. With complete characteristic data, the same semiclassical exterior supports both descriptions, analogous to the Heisenberg and Schrödinger pictures through state--operator duality. Using a gravitational charge as a quantum clock, we construct a modular crossed product with density operators whose trace entropy reproduces generalized entropy up to clock contributions. Our approach parallels thermodynamics in regulated field theory and formulates the GSL through a quantum channel fluctuation theorem (FT) for the open exterior. We develop three complementary formulations under specified dynamical assumptions. Separated unitary driving and relaxation combine modular work, the physical-process first law relating horizon absorption to area gain, and relative-entropy contraction through data processing. A time-local description accommodates simultaneous unitary driving and dissipation. A two-time surprisal FT treats the complete channel, identifies the nonunital correction, and yields a GSL bound for unital dressed evolution without resolving intermediate dynamics. Relaxation that does not mix distinct dressed-charge sectors and preserves the full dressed reference state is unital. Unitality is sufficient for this FT proof but is not necessary for the GSL along a particular evolution. The entropy bounds establish the GSL in a controlled slow-clock limit and quantify finite-width clock corrections.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在量子参考系与模交叉积框架下重新表述黑洞外部广义第二定律，并借助量子通道涨落定理给出三种互补表述，理论上较为深入，对黑洞热力学与引力的量子基础均有参考价值；虽涉及纠缠熵等全息式工具，但主线是黑洞热力学，故归入 black_hole_thermodynamics。
decision.title_zh: 量子参考系中由涨落定理导出的广义第二定律
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明：对于在固定半有限代数上进行幺正驱动与弛豫的黑洞外部区域，广义第二定律（GSL）成立。Wall 颇具影响力的证明假设半经典几何，并把固定的母态限制于相继视界截面的代数上。我们改为在固定的“着装”外部代数上演化态。在具备完整特征数据的情况下，同一半经典外部既支持这两种描述，正如通过态—算符对偶联系的海森堡图景与薛定谔图景。我们以引力荷作为量子时钟，构造出带密度算子的模交叉积，其迹熵在计入时钟贡献后重现广义熵。我们的方法可与受调控场论中的热力学相类比，并通过适用于开放外部区域的量子通道涨落定理（FT）来表述 GSL。我们在指定的动力学假设下发展了三种互补的表述。分离的幺正驱动与弛豫结合了模功、将视界吸收与面积增加相联系的物理过程第一定律，以及通过数据处理得到的相对熵收缩。时间局域描述可容纳同时发生的幺正驱动与耗散。双时刻惊讶度（surprisal）FT 处理完整的通道，识别出非幺正（nonunital）修正，并给出对幺正着装演化的 GSL 界，而无需解析中间动力学。不混合不同着装荷扇区且保持完整着装参考态的弛豫是幺正的。幺正性对于这一 FT 证明是充分的，但对于沿某一特定演化的 GSL 却并非必要。这些熵界在受控的缓慢时钟极限下确立了 GSL，并量化了有限宽度时钟修正。
